scope: cloud-resilient date grouping, output reshuffle staging, and USB rebuild
sources_relied_upon: Current pipeline, CLI, manifest schema, and test suite
Configured iCloud Photos source and OneDrive-backed USB output
material_decisions: Date grouping now logs and skips a source that disappears after fingerprinting instead of aborting the rebuild.
Report-path formatting avoids resolving mounted Windows paths before converting them to Windows form.
Output-only reshuffle stages files with hard links when available and falls back to copying.
validation_performed: Verified the OneDrive volume supports hard links.
open_questions: The active full rebuild must still clear the OneDrive-backed reports directory after its source scan; that can be blocked by a Windows file lock.
recommended_next_step: Monitor the active full rebuild and, if it reaches a report-folder lock, release the Windows/OneDrive lock before retrying.
